name: Sterling-Nakamura Emergency Transponder ET-5
description: A concealed emergency beacon that, when activated, broadcasts an encrypted distress signal containing the user's identity, location, biometric status, and a 10-second audio recording to Sterling-Nakamura's security response network. The ET-5 is designed to be activated covertly — a specific gesture, a pressure pattern, or a neural interface command — without alerting nearby threats. The beacon transmits through multiple redundant channels including satellite, cellular, and mesh network, ensuring the signal gets out even in jammed environments. Sterling-Nakamura guarantees a response within 15 minutes in covered areas.

specifications.info: pressure pattern; or neural command; pendant; or subdermal implant

story_hooks: An ET-5 activated inside a sealed underground chamber where no signal should have escaped — the beacon's mesh network redundancy found a path through building wiring, and the response team arrived within 20 minutes.
An ET-5 signal was received from a user who was confirmed dead 6 hours prior — either the beacon malfunctioned, or someone is wearing a dead person's emergency transponder.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist smart ring with a slightly raised crown housing a translucent sapphire lens. The band appears seamless, wrapping around the finger with an almost organic flow. At rest, it looks like expensive jewelry rather than survival tech—intentionally understated.
physical_description.dimensions: Ring diameter: ~22mm; crown height: 8mm above band surface; fits standard ring sizing (US 4–13)
physical_description.weight_description: Pocketable/wearable—barely perceptible on the finger; 20 grams total
physical_description.primary_material: Titanium alloy band with synthetic sapphire crown; graphene-infused composite interior housing
physical_description.finish: Polished satin on band; high-gloss on crown; laser-etched micro-circuitry visible under the sapphire under magnification
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray band with matte charcoal accents; the crown has a faint opalescent sheen that shifts blue-to-amber depending on angle and charge state
physical_description.interface_elements: Crown pressure sensor (haptic feedback); no visible buttons; subtle LED indicator ring around inner band base (only visible when worn—red for armed, green for ready, amber for low battery); wireless induction charging pad contacts on interior
distinctive_features: Opalescent sapphire crown that glows faintly when transmission is active
Near-invisible gesture activation—squeeze-twist or double-tap pattern on the band
Micro-antenna array embedded in the titanium, no external protrusions
Haptic pulse feedback system for silent acknowledgment
Sterling-Nakamura logo laser-etched inside band (visible only to wearer)
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Subtle 'S-N' sigil on outer band face (2mm); regulatory micro-text on inner surface; holographic authenticity seal integrated into packaging only
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn casually as everyday jewelry; under normal use shows no visible wear; the crown may develop micro-scratches over years but remains functional and cosmetically subtle
